description: LLM Judge evaluator for SQL agent

evaluatorConfig.name: LLMJudgeOutputEvaluator
evaluatorConfig.description: Evaluates semantic similarity of SQL query results
evaluatorConfig.prompt:
As an expert SQL evaluator, analyze the semantic similarity of the actual SQL query result to the expected result. Score from 0-100 (where 0 means completely different and 100 means identical/equivalent in meaning).

Focus on:
1. Comparing the actual result to the expected result - content matters more than formatting
2. Check if all expected data points are present in the actual output
3. Verify no incorrect data is present in the actual output
4. Account for reasonable variations in phrasing (e.g., "Greatest Hits" vs "The album is Greatest Hits")

Provide your score with a brief justification.
----
ExpectedOutput:
{{ExpectedOutput}}
----
ActualOutput:
{{ActualOutput}}
